set.note: Ezra names the start (Babylon, by the Ahava canal) and the end; the caravan road between is not recorded. Nehemiah's later journey from Susa is its own journey.

steps.label: The decree
steps.copy: Cyrus king of Persia lets the exiles go home to rebuild the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.

steps.label: Ezra sets out
steps.copy: Ezra gathers the returning families by the Ahava canal, and they fast and pray for a safe journey.

steps.label: Arrival at Jerusalem
steps.copy: About four months later, the gracious hand of God on them, they arrive and rest three days.

steps.label: Fleeing toward Haran
steps.copy: Jacob leaves Beersheba for Laban's home in Haran.

steps.label: The dream at Bethel
steps.copy: He dreams of a stairway reaching to heaven, and God renews the promise to him.

steps.label: Twenty years with Laban
steps.copy: He marries Leah and Rachel and grows wealthy in Haran.

steps.label: Wrestling at Peniel
steps.copy: By the Jabbok he wrestles until daybreak and is renamed Israel.

steps.label: Safe arrival at Shechem
steps.copy: He arrives safely at Shechem in Canaan and sets up an altar there.

steps.label: Crossing the Jordan
steps.copy: The river is cut off upstream and Israel crosses on dry ground.

steps.label: Camp at Gilgal
steps.copy: Twelve stones from the riverbed are set up as a memorial.

steps.label: Jericho falls
steps.copy: On the seventh day they march around seven times, shout, and the wall collapses.

steps.label: Ai taken on the second try
steps.copy: Defeat because of hidden sin, then victory in the hills.

steps.label: The Gibeonites' treaty
steps.copy: The Gibeonites come to the camp at Gilgal pretending to be from far away, and Israel makes a treaty with them.

steps.label: Defending Gibeon
steps.copy: Joshua marches all night from Gilgal to rescue Gibeon, and the sun stands still.

set.note: 2 Chronicles 3:1 places Solomon's temple on Mount Moriah, so the mountain is shown at Jerusalem's Temple Mount, the traditional site.
The servant's road between Aram and the Negev is not recorded.
Exodus names only Egypt and Midian; Moses' road between them is not recorded.

points.modern: northwest Arabia, by the Gulf of Aqaba

steps.label: Fleeing Pharaoh
steps.copy: After killing an Egyptian, Moses runs from Pharaoh.

steps.label: At the well of Midian
steps.copy: He helps the priest's daughters at the well and is welcomed into the family.

steps.label: The ark is captured
steps.copy: Israel is routed and the ark of God is taken.

steps.label: Dagon falls in Ashdod
steps.copy: Twice the idol of Dagon is found fallen face down before the ark.

steps.label: Moved to Gath
steps.copy: They move the ark to Gath, and the Lord's hand is against that city too.

steps.label: Ekron cries out
steps.copy: When it reaches Ekron, the people cry out to send it back.

steps.label: Returned to Beth Shemesh
steps.copy: Two cows pull the cart straight back to Israel, lowing as they go.

steps.label: Leaving Damascus
steps.copy: Naaman sets out with silver, gold and a letter to the king of Israel.

steps.label: Sent to the Jordan
steps.copy: Elisha sends word: wash in the Jordan seven times. Naaman goes away angry.

steps.label: Healed in the river
steps.copy: He dips seven times, and his flesh is restored like a young child's.

steps.label: Back to Elisha
steps.copy: He returns to Elisha and says there is no God in all the earth except in Israel.

points.modern: on the way to Moab (spot unknown)

steps.label: Rahab hides the spies
steps.copy: Two spies from Shittim lodge at Rahab's house in Jericho, and she hides them on her roof.

steps.label: Let down the wall
steps.copy: She lowers them by a rope through her window, and they hide in the hills for three days.

steps.label: Report to Joshua
steps.copy: They cross back and tell Joshua the Lord has given the land into their hands.

steps.label: Crossing the Jordan
steps.copy: The waters stand up in a heap, and Israel crosses over on dry ground.
